justifications.durability: restoring the base rule reddens the acceptance case alone (negative-control.log: FAILED tests/test_a_review_promotes_what_it_passed.py::test_promotion_finds_nothing_outside_the_review_declarations, 1 failed, 6 passed, EXIT=1), and each acceptance is paired with a refusal at tests/test_a_review_promotes_what_it_passed.py:231 and :251 whose assertions compare the rule's verdict against constants rather than against values the test handed it; the residual is that the end-to-end promotion case passes with the mutation, so the guard pins the rule's verdict rather than a review's promotion outcome.
justifications.evidence: both arms are logged with revision, tree, module and command and end in EXIT=1, the head arm's added-failure set is empty when re-derived from suite-base.log and suite-head.log against a positive control (73 ids at base, 65 at head, swapped arms yielding 8), and negative-control.log names its mutation and ends EXIT=1 at 1 failed and 6 passed; the ruff figure in the manifest's artifacts line does not reproduce as worded, which the finding records.
justifications.fit: the delegation reuses the shared rule and, through reckon/crew/reports.py:1187, the existing declaration mapping, the docstring at reckon/crew/promotion.py:2078 states why the recorded worktree is the resolution base rather than the caller's tree, the naming checks over the added diff lines return nothing, and ruff reports the same three findings at base and head.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:2102 now calls the shared rule, so a changed path, a declaration and the worktree it resolves against are judged once for both surfaces and cannot drift; the residual is that the only call site (reckon/crew/promotion.py:5656) is fed the run's committed paths, which a review's store record can never be, so the acceptance tests/test_a_review_promotes_what_it_passed.py:197 demonstrates is entered directly and no review's promotion verdict changed.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 3d8e1a680..b3683d8e6 is exactly the three paths the manifest declares, every one inside the four granted write paths, the unused figure grant is declared unused in the landing line, and the reviewed worktree is clean at the head.
